en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a riverside town dominated by a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire. There are boats on the calm river in the foreground. The top front of the card has handwritten text in a Slavic language and the printed phrase 'Gruss aus Essek' (Greetings from Essek). The back side contains address information written in cursive, a stamp, and postal markings, as well as printed text in Hungarian and Croatian.
